vizier_flare_rotation_tables.adql: SELECT table_name, description FROM TAP_SCHEMA.tables WHERE table_name LIKE 'J/ApJS/241/29/%' OR table_name LIKE 'J/ApJS/211/24/%' OR table_name LIKE 'J/ApJS/253/35/%' OR table_name LIKE 'J/ApJ/935/143/%' OR table_name LIKE 'J/ApJS/225/15/%' OR table_name LIKE 'J/A+A/570/A128/%' OR table_name LIKE 'J/AJ/159/177/%' OR table_name LIKE 'J/MNRAS/467/4970/%' OR table_name LIKE 'J/A+A/555/A104/%' OR table_name LIKE 'J/A+A/608/A113/%' OR table_name LIKE 'J/A+A/651/A45/%' OR table_name LIKE 'J/ApJ/876/58/%' OR table_name LIKE 'J/ApJ/829/23/%' OR table_name LIKE 'J/AJ/159/60/%'
vizier_flare_rotation_tables.why: Named VizieR tables the briefs assert exist: Yang & Liu 2019 flares, McQuillan 2014 rotation, TESS flare catalogues, Cotten & Song 2016 debris census, Ertel 2014 PIONIER exozodi, Ertel 2020 HOSTS, Hollands 2017 DZ.

vizier_moor2021_edd.adql: SELECT table_name, description FROM TAP_SCHEMA.tables WHERE table_name LIKE 'J/ApJ/910/27/%' OR table_name LIKE 'J/MNRAS/433/2334/%' OR table_name LIKE 'J/ApJS/225/15/%' OR table_name LIKE 'J/ApJ/805/77/%' OR (description LIKE '%Moor%' AND description LIKE '%debris%')
vizier_moor2021_edd.why: Moór+2021 EDD table, Kennedy & Wyatt 2013 warm-dust LF, Cotten & Song 2016 census, Meng+2015 EDD photometry (run 1 found only the last, by description).

vizier_search_debris_extreme.adql: SELECT table_name, description FROM TAP_SCHEMA.tables WHERE description LIKE '%extreme debris%' OR description LIKE '%warm debris%' OR description LIKE '%debris disk%census%' OR description LIKE '%debris disc%census%'
vizier_search_debris_extreme.head: [{"table_name": "\"J/ApJ/805/77/table2\"", "description": "Spitzer/IRAC photometry of the systems with extreme debris disk ( Meng H.Y.A., Su K.Y.L., Rieke G.H., Rujopakarn W., Myers G., Cook M., Erdelyi E., Maloney C., McMath J., Persha G., Poshyachinda S., Reichart D.E.)"}]

vizier_search_exozodi.adql: SELECT table_name, description FROM TAP_SCHEMA.tables WHERE description LIKE '%exozodi%' OR description LIKE '%PIONIER%' OR description LIKE '%FLUOR%' OR description LIKE '%hot dust%'
vizier_search_exozodi.head: [{"table_name": "\"J/ApJS/215/15/comp\"", "description": "SMaSH+ companion detections with  PIONIER (PIO), NACO/SAM (SAM) and NACO FOV (NACO) ( Sana H., Le Bouquin J.-B., Lacour S., Berger J.-P., Duvert G., Gauchet L., Norris B., Olofsson J., Pickel D., Zins G., Absil O., de Koter A., Kratter K., Schnurr O., Zinnecker H.)"}, {"table_name": "\"J/MNRAS/489/1572/tables5\"", "description": "Near-IR spectral light curves corresponding to the hot dust ( Landt H., Ward M.J., Kynoch D., et al.)"}]
vizier_search_exozodi.why: Any interferometric exozodi survey table VizieR serves.

vizier_search_polluted_wd.adql: SELECT table_name, description FROM TAP_SCHEMA.tables WHERE table_name LIKE 'J/A+A/691/A352%' OR description LIKE '%polluted%white dwarf%' OR description LIKE '%DZ white dwarf%' OR description LIKE '%PEWDD%'
vizier_search_polluted_wd.head: [{"table_name": "\"J/A+A/691/A352/pewdd\"", "description": "PEWDD catalog ( Williams J.T., Gaensicke B.T., Swan A., O'Brien M.W., Izquierdo P., Cutolo A-M., Cunningham T.)"}, {"table_name": "\"J/MNRAS/492/2683/tablea1\"", "description": "The polluted white dwarfs where both calcium and iron were detected, as used in this work ( Bonsor A., Carter P.J., Hollands M., Gansicke B.T., Leinhardt Z., Harrison J.H.D.)"}, {"table_name": "\"J/other/SCPMA/57.176/table5\"", "description": "New DZ white dwarfs ( Si J.M., Luo A.L., Li Y.B., Zhang J.N., Wei P., Wu Y.H., Wu F.C., Zhao Y.H.)"}]
vizier_search_polluted_wd.why: PEWDD at VizieR (J/A+A/691/A352) and any other polluted-WD abundance table.

vizier_superflare_tables.adql: SELECT table_name, description FROM TAP_SCHEMA.tables WHERE table_name LIKE 'J/ApJ/876/58%' OR table_name LIKE 'J/ApJ/906/72%' OR table_name LIKE 'J/ApJS/253/35%' OR description LIKE '%superflare%'
vizier_superflare_tables.head: [{"table_name": "\"J/ApJ/906/72/table2\"", "description": "Parameters of superflares on solar-type stars ( Okamoto S., Notsu Y., Maehara H., Namekata K., Honda S., Ikuta K., Nogami D., Shibata K.)"}, {"table_name": "\"J/ApJ/935/90/table2\"", "description": "Information of superflare candidates ( Tu Z.-L., Wu Q., Wang W., Zhang G.Q., Liu Z.-K., Wang F.Y.)"}, {"table_name": "\"J/ApJS/209/5/stars\"", "description": "The 279 G-type dwarfs with superflares (table added by CDS) ( Shibayama T., Maehara H., Notsu S., Notsu Y., Nagao T., Honda S., Ishii T.T., Nogami D., Shibata K.)"}, {"table_name": "\"J/other/Nat/485.478/tables1\"", "description": "List of G-type main sequence stars showing superflares ( Maehara H., Shibayama T., Notsu S., Notsu Y., Nagao T., Kusaba S., Honda S., Nogami D., Shibata K.)"}]
vizier_superflare_tables.why: Notsu+2019 / Okamoto+2021 / Tu+2021 superflare tables carrying per-star spot amplitude AND per-flare energy (the two columns the spot-ceiling residual needs).

vizier_tap_home.why: VizieR TAP: flare, rotation, exozodi, debris-disk and polluted-WD catalogues are read through it (probed below by ADQL).
